正統七年進士登科錄

玉音

正統七年三月初五日早，禮部尚書臣胡濙等官於奉天門奏為科舉事：會試天下舉人，選中一百五十名。本年三月十五日殿試，合請讀卷及執事等官，少師、兵部尚書兼華蓋殿大學士楊士奇，少保、禮部尚書兼武英殿大學士楊溥等四十一員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
光祿大夫、柱國、少師、兵部尚書兼華蓋殿大學士楊士奇〔儒士〕
translation_en:
Record of Metropolitan Graduates of the Seventh Year of the Zhengtong Reign (1442)

Imperial Rescript

Early in the morning on the fifth day of the third month of the seventh year of the Zhengtong reign, your servant Hu Ying 胡濙, Minister of Rites, and other officials submitted a memorial at the Fengtian Gate concerning civil service examination affairs: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates (juren) from throughout the empire, one hundred and fifty candidates have been selected. For the Palace Examination on the fifteenth day of the third month of the present year, it is fitting to request the appointment of Examination Readers and functionaries, totaling forty-one officials, including Yang Shiqi 楊士奇, Junior Preceptor, Minister of War, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall, and Yang Pu 楊溥, Junior Guardian, Minister of Rites, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall. As for the grades of qualification of the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), we respectfully follow the qualifications imperially established by Grand Progenitor Emperor Gao (the Hongwu Emperor): in the First Class, three candidates are selected by precedent, with the first-place candidate accorded rank 6b and the second- and third-place candidates accorded rank 7a, all conferred the title of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi); those of the Second Class are accorded rank 7b and conferred the title of Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen); those of the Third Class are accorded rank 8a and conferred the title of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen). We received the Imperial Edict: "Approved. Respect this."

Examination Readers
Yang Shiqi 楊士奇, Grandee of the Eleventh Class, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor, Minister of War, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall (Confucian scholar [rushi]).

translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Honors (Enrong cidi)

Seventh year of the Zhengtong reign (1442)

Early on the fifteenth day of the third month, the Tribute Scholars (gongshi, successful candidates of the Metropolitan Examination) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination. The Emperor took his seat in the Fengtian Hall (Hall of Revering Heaven) and personally bestowed the policy question.

Early on the seventeenth day of the third month, all civil and military officials stood in attendance in their court robes. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei) set out the Imperial Processional Regalia (lubu) upon the Cinnabar Stairway (danbi) and within the Cinnabar Courtyard (danchi). The Emperor took his seat in the Fengtian Hall, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglusi) transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names of the graduates (changming). Officials of the Ministry of Rites (Libu) carried the Yellow Placard (huangbang), led by drums and music, out through the Left Chang'an Gate to be posted. Once this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture used a ceremonial parasol and retinue to escort the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan, Optimus) back to his residence.

translation_en:
On the eighteenth day of the third month, an imperial banquet was bestowed at the Ministry of Rites; after the banquet concluded, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial to rehearse the court rituals.
On the nineteenth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) was bestowed court dress, cap, and belt, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi) were bestowed paper money (baochao).
On the twentieth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates in presenting a memorial of gratitude for imperial grace.
On the twenty-first day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai). The Ministry of Rites submitted a memorial requesting that the Ministry of Works be ordered to erect a stone stele at the Directorate of Education inscribed with their names.

Both his father and stepmother are living; his elder brothers are Wei 渭, Jing 涇, and Pu 浦, and his younger brother is Si 肆; he is betrothed to Lady Sheng 盛氏. He placed forty-third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zou Yunlong 鄒允隆 [registered in Taining County 泰寧縣, Shaowu Prefecture 邵武府, Fujian 福建, under civilian household status; a Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yunlong 允隆; tenth in generational order; aged twenty-nine, born on the third day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Linfu 林甫; his grandfather was Shirong 世榮; his father is An 安 [Instructor in the Directorate of Education]; and his mother is Lady Xiao 蕭氏. Both his parents are living; his elder brother is Yunchong 允崇, and his younger brother is Yunsheng 允升; he married Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Kui 姚夔 [registered in Tonglu County 桐廬縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang 浙江, under civilian household status; a [?] Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Dazhang 大章; seventh in generational order; aged twenty-nine, born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Ding 鼎; his grandfather was Bohua 伯華; his father was Weishan 惟善; and his mother is Lady Shentu 申屠氏. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Kexin 克信, Kexian 克賢, Kegong 克恭, and Kecheng 克成; he married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ning Ying 甯瑛 [registered in Jishan County 稷山縣, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西, under civilian household status; a County School Student; specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Tingyu 廷玉; fourth in generational order; aged thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Boshan 伯善; his grandfather was Xiaoxian 孝賢 [former Assistant Magistrate of Lijin County 利津縣]; his father is Liang 良; his mother was Lady Yuan 原氏; and his stepmother is Lady Duan 段氏. Both his father and stepmother are living; his elder brothers are Bing 秉, Xuan 瑄, and Zhi 智, and his younger brother is Guan 瓘; he married Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed seventeenth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

朱榮〔貫福建漳州府長泰縣匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字廷寵，行一，年二十七，九月十八日生〕。曾祖銘甫，祖若茂，父彥緝，母陳氏。具慶下，弟英、真、興、珎、震、著、萃，娶余氏。福建鄉試第三十六名，會試第七十七名。

劉曦〔貫江西吉安府萬安縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字玉暉，行一，年四十四，九月十三日生〕。曾祖國定，祖務濟，父孟淵，母郭氏。慈侍下，弟玉琚、玉珣，娶謝氏。江西鄉試第五十九名，會試第五十七名。

王復〔貫順天府固安縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字初陽，行四，年二十七，五月初十日生〕。曾祖遜，祖得玉，父騏〔州同知掌舞陽縣事〕，母楊氏，繼母許氏。慈侍下，兄徵、徑、倫，弟德、徽、微，娶齊氏。順天府鄉試第十一名，會試第九十名。

張瀾〔貫四川瀘州軍籍，州學增廣生，治《書經》，字道本，行三，年三十七，十一月初一日生〕。曾祖義敏，祖德明，父子偉，母賀氏。慈侍下，兄漢、濬〔禮部主事〕，娶歐陽氏。四川鄉試第二名，會試第二名。
translation_en:
Zhu Rong 朱榮 (registered in an artisan household in Changtai County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Tingchong, first in seniority; age twenty-seven, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Mingfu, his grandfather was Ruomao, his father is Yanqi, and his mother is née Chen. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Ying, Zhen, Xing, Zhen, Zhen, Zhu, and Cui; he is married to née Yu. He placed thirty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Xi 劉曦 (registered in a civilian household in Wan'an County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; County School Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yuhui, first in seniority; age forty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Guoding, his grandfather was Wuji, his father was Mengyuan, and his mother is née Guo. His mother is living (his father having died); his younger brothers are Yuju and Yuxun; he is married to née Xie. He placed fifty-ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Fu 王復 (registered in a military household in Gu'an County, Shuntian Prefecture; County School Student, specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Chuyang, fourth in seniority; age twenty-seven, born on the tenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Xun, his grandfather was Deyu, his father was Qi (Vice Subprefect in charge of the affairs of Wuyang County), his mother was née Yang, and his stepmother is née Xu. His stepmother is living (his father having died); his elder brothers are Zheng, Jing, and Lun, and his younger brothers are De, Hui, and Wei; he is married to née Qi. He placed eleventh in the Shuntian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Lan 張瀾 (registered in a military household in Luzhou, Sichuan; Added Student in the Subprefectural School, specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Daoben, third in seniority; age thirty-seven, born on the first day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Yimin, his grandfather was Deming, his father was Ziwei, and his mother is née He. His mother is living (his father having died); his elder brothers are Han and Jun (Secretary in the Ministry of Rites); he is married to née Ouyang. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xie Yannian 解延年 (registered in Qixia County, Dengzhou Prefecture, Shandong, under military household registration; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shiji, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-seven sui, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Gu Bao; his grandfather was Zhongxing; his father is Qiang (Instructor in the Confucian School of Sanyuan County); his father's principal wife was Lady Song, his stepmother is Lady Du, and his birth mother is Lady Zhao. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Yanling and Yanshou, and his younger brothers are Yanzu and Yanzong. He married Lady Ji. He placed second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 107th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Sen 李森 (registered in Changle County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under civilian household registration; a Lesser Functionary in the Censorate specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shuyan, first in seniority among his brothers, aged forty sui, born on the seventh day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Benchu; his grandfather was Fusun; his father is Mengqiong; his mother is Lady Lin. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Xin, Hong, and Jia. He married Lady Lin, with Lady Chen as his second wife. He placed fourteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Ru 宋儒 (ancestrally registered in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, under military household registration; a Military Student in the Ningxia Front Guard in Shaanxi specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zonglu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-seven sui, born on the twenty-second day of the intercalary seventh month). His great-grandfather was Weiqing (School Registrar of Qingyuan Route under the Yuan); his grandfather was Jingwen; his father was Zisheng; his mother is Lady Xu. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He married Lady Gong. He placed second in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Shang 黃裳 (ancestrally registered in Xingguo County, Ganzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, under military household registration; a Military Student in the Xingning Chiliarchy in Guangdong specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuanji, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six sui, born on the twelfth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Yuangui; his grandfather was Zhongli; his father is Xiang; his mother was Lady He, and his stepmother is Lady Liu. Both parents are living. He married Lady Ye. He placed eleventh in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

余瓚〔貫江西饒州府德興縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字世用，行十三，年三十一，九月二十一日生〕。曾祖正卿〔元本府儒學教授〕；祖叔通〔新城縣河泊所大使〕；父瑗〔長寧縣學教諭〕；母曾氏。具慶下。兄璉；弟瑞、珙。娶魯氏。江西鄉試第二十五名，會試第六十九名。

左鼎〔貫江西吉安府永新縣民籍，儒士，治《易經》，字周器，行三，年三十四，八月二十八日生〕。曾祖持敬；祖子肅；父承箕；母王氏。具慶下。兄魯莊、楚芳。娶劉氏。江西鄉試第五十名，會試第三十八名。
translation_en:
Pan Ying 潘英 (registered under a military household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a county student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Shiyan, third in seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Yunzhong; his grandfather was Shangzhi; his father is Boyi; and his mother is née Wu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Shou and Ning, and he is married to a woman née Xu. He placed fortieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Jian 潘鑑 (registered under a civilian household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a county student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shuzhan, first in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Jingyue (who served as Assistant Prefect of Anfu Subprefecture); his grandfather is Huichu; his father is Duoji; and his mother is née Zhou. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Nao, Yong, and Yi, and he is married to a woman née Xu. He placed thirty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Zan 余瓚 (registered under a civilian household in Dexing County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; an expectant student at the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shiyong, thirteenth in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhengqing (Instructor in the Confucian School of this prefecture under the Yuan); his grandfather was Shutong (Commissioner of the Xincheng County Fishing Tax Office); his father is Yuan (Instructor of the Changning County School); and his mother is née Zeng. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Lian, his younger brothers are Rui and Gong, and he is married to a woman née Lu. He placed twenty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and sixty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zuo Ding 左鼎 (registered under a civilian household in Yongxin County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Confucian scholar specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zhouqi, third in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Chijing; his grandfather was Zisu; his father is Chengji; and his mother is née Wang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Luzhuang and Chufang, and he is married to a woman née Liu. He placed fiftieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

南昱〔貫浙江温州府樂清縣，竈籍，刑部吏，治《書經》，字時芳，行一，年三十七，十一月十四日生〕。曾祖子正；祖彥武；父繼浩；母徐氏。具慶下。弟嘉、堪、頖、昉、範。娶鄭氏。順天府鄉試第十九名，會試第三十三名。

translation_en:
Bao Liangzuo 包良佐 (registered in Lanxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; County School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Kezhong; second in his generation; age twenty-five, born on the twenty-third day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Bao Xixian (Surveillance Vice Commissioner of Huguang); his grandfather was Bao Zongyuan; his father was Bao Yonghe; and his mother is née Jiang. His mother is alive while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Bao Liangjie, and his younger brother is Bao Liangzhong. He married née Yu. He ranked second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Zhenwang 孫振望 (registered in Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian household status; Added Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; personal name Yan 儼; seventh in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Sun Shihe; his grandfather was Sun Boyan; his father was Sun Renxian; his mother was née Yang; and his adoptive mother is née Ren. His mother is alive while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Sun Zhenyong, Sun Zhenxi, and Sun Zhentai; his younger brothers are Sun Jiasheng [?] and Sun Zhenrang. He married née Xiong. He ranked fourteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Nan Yu 南昱 (registered in Yueqing County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under salt-producer household status; Lesser Functionary in the Ministry of Justice specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Shifang; first in his generation; age thirty-seven, born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Nan Zizheng; his grandfather was Nan Yanwu; his father is Nan Jihao; and his mother is née Xu. Both of his parents are alive. His younger brothers are Nan Jia, Nan Kan, Nan Pan, Nan Fang, and Nan Fan. He married née Zheng. He ranked nineteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Bin 沈彬 (registered in Wukang County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yuanzhi; first in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the seventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Shen Zheng'er; his grandfather was Shen Shisheng; his father is Shen Siyi (Police Chief of the Duning Police Office in Nanhai County); and his mother is née Feng. Both of his parents are alive. He married née Wu, with née Qian as his successor wife. He ranked eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Hong Sheng 洪繩 (native of Qingtian County, Chuzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a Civilian Household; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Wengang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Shiliang, his grandfather was Tianyu, his father was Junpeng, his father's principal wife was Lady Liu, and his birth mother is Lady Wang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Shen and Zhen (Assistant Magistrate of Daxing County), and his younger brothers are Hong, Zhen, and Ji. He is married to Lady Ye. He placed sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and forty-second [?] (transcribed "eight-forty-second") in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Long 姚龍 (native of Tonglu County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a Civilian Household; County Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals; courtesy name Nayan; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Ding, his grandfather was Bohua, his father is Hong (Vice Magistrate of Xincheng County), his father's former wife was Lady Yu, and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Keqi, and his younger brothers are Xian and Sheng. He is married to Lady Yuan. He placed eleventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Xu 鄭序 (native of Changle County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, registered in a Civilian Household; Added Student in the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zhili; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the eighteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Kui, his grandfather was Shunian, his father was Lu, and his mother is Lady Chen. His mother is living. His elder brother is Yu, and his younger brothers are Yan and Lian. He is married to Lady Lin. He placed forty-fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Kai 劉鍇 (native of Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered in a Civilian Household; Added Student in the Prefectural School of Lin'an Prefecture, Yunnan; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Yongfu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zhongxiang, his grandfather was Tingshi, his father was Yi (Instructor of the Lin'an Prefectural School), and his mother is Lady Zeng. His mother is living. His elder brother is Zhao (Instructor of the Lishui County School), and his younger brothers are Jin (Assistant Instructor of the Yingtian Prefectural School) and Yao. He is married to Lady Sun. He placed second in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Zhengfang 李正芳 [registered as a commoner native to Macheng County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yanshuo, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Youde 友德, his grandfather was Li Sijing 思敬, his father is Li Yuan 瑗, and his mother is née Zou 鄒. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Dafang 大芳, Li Nengfang 能芳, and Li Shanfang 善芳. He is married to née Zhang 張. He placed 21st in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 79th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yunhan 張雲翰 [registered as a commoner native to Deyang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; a County School Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yingyang, first in seniority among his brothers, aged forty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Heqing 和卿, his grandfather was Zhang Gui 珪 [Department Magistrate of Jie Department], his father was Zhang Ding 鼎, and his mother was née Zhang 章. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Zhang Zheng 政 and Zhang Zhe 轍. He is married to née Wang 王. He placed 1st in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 19th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Fu 劉福 [registered as a commoner native to Jian'an County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian; a Prefectural School Student, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Chongshan, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the sixth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Xuanyi 宣義, his grandfather was Liu Ximeng 希孟, his father is Liu Zhongyu 仲玉, and his mother is née You 游. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Liu Shou 壽. He is married to née Wang 王. He placed 16th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 63rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Jian 俞鑑 [registered as a commoner native to Tonglu County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a County School Student, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yuanqi, eighteenth in seniority among his cousins, aged thirty, born on the twenty-first day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Jing'an 靜安, his grandfather was Yu Wenjing 文敬, his father is Yu Shen 深 [Instructor in the Prefectural Confucian School of Jianning Prefecture], his mother was née Wang 王, and his stepmother was née Zhang 張. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Yu Qi 錡, Yu Yong 鏞, and Yu Huang 鐄, and his younger brothers are Yu E 鍔 and Yu Nao 鐃. He is married to née Yao 姚. He placed 15th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 11th in the Metropolitan Examination.

熊璘〔貫河南汝寧府羅山縣民籍，縣學生，治《春秋》，字文玉，行一，年三十三，十一月二十日生〕。曾祖成德；祖添恕；父友〔陝西宜川縣主簿〕；母杜氏。重慶下。弟琦、琥、琛、玘。娶蔡氏。河南鄉試第一名，會試第二十四名。

王儼〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字民望，行二，年二十九，六月十一日生〕。曾祖復初；祖麟昭；父彥瑞；嫡母趙氏，母郭氏。具慶下。兄民彝，弟民表。娶彭氏。江西鄉試第四十七名，會試第一百四十八名。
translation_en:
Lu Wen 魯文 (registered in a military household of Xiangyin County 湘陰縣, Changsha Prefecture 長沙府, Huguang 湖廣; a National University Student [guozi sheng] specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Wenming 文明; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the seventeenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Dehua 德華; his grandfather was Tianrui 天瑞 (Messenger [xingren]); his father was Zhixue 志學; his mother was née Xiao 蕭, and his stepmother was née Fu 傅. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Wencong 文聰 and Wenchang 文昌, and his younger brother is Wenyu 文郁. He married née Shi 施. He placed first in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jian 李鑑 (registered in a military household of Anhua County 安化縣, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Mingyuan 明遠; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Boying 伯英; his grandfather was Weilong 惟隆 (Fuyuan Garrison [Fuyuan zhen] [?]); his father was Dingyan 鼎言 (Tribute Student [gongshi] of the jiawu year [1414]); and his mother was née Yang 楊. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhao 釗 and Yong 鏞, and his younger brother is Quan 銓. He married née Zhou 周. He placed thirtieth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and twenty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Lin 熊璘 (registered in a civilian household of Luoshan County 羅山縣, Runing Prefecture 汝寧府, Henan 河南; a County Student [xian xuesheng] specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Wenyu 文玉; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twentieth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Chengde 成德; his grandfather was Tianshu 添恕; his father was You 友 (Assistant Magistrate [zhubu] of Yichuan County 宜川縣, Shaanxi 陝西); and his mother was née Du 杜. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Qi 琦, Hu 琥, Chen 琛, and Qi 玘. He married née Cai 蔡. He placed first in the Henan Provincial Examination and twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yan 王儼 (registered in a civilian household of Taihe County 泰和縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; an Added County Student [xianxue zengguang sheng] specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Minwang 民望; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the eleventh day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Fuchu 復初; his grandfather was Linzhao 麟昭; his father was Yanrui 彥瑞; his legal mother was née Zhao 趙, and his birth mother was née Guo 郭. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Minyi 民彝, and his younger brother is Minbiao 民表. He married née Peng 彭. He placed forty-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Huafu 劉華甫 (registered as a civilian householder of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Huafu; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first lunar month): His great-grandfather was Liu Hanguang (posthumously honoured as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), his grandfather Liu Zhijie, his father Liu Gongcui, and his mother Lady Nie. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Liu Huafu 華黻, Liu Huafeng, Liu Huawen, Liu Zhangfu, and Liu Huaqing, and he is married to Lady Chen. He placed second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gan Fan 干璠 (registered as a civilian householder of Bazhou, Shuntian Prefecture; a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingyu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the tenth day of the first lunar month): His great-grandfather was Gan Wenli, his grandfather Gan Zhongxuan, his father Gan Shizhong, and his mother Lady Chu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Gan Qu, his younger brothers are Gan Lin, Gan Pin, and Gan Cheng, and he is betrothed to Lady Weng. He placed fifty-third in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Yong 韓雍 (registered as a civilian householder of Wanping County, Shuntian Prefecture; a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yongxi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-one, born on the ninth day of the eleventh lunar month): His great-grandfather was Han Yanjie, his grandfather Han Juyi, his father Han Gui, and his mother Lady Zhao. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Han Mu, and he is married to Lady Wang. He placed fifty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

秦顒〔貫直隸常州府武進縣，軍籍，貴州宣慰使司學軍生，治《詩經》，字士昂，行一，年三十，五月十八日生〕。曾祖仲明〔百戶〕；祖孟禮；父義；母朱氏。具慶下。弟顯。娶郗氏。雲南鄉試第十一名，會試第一百四名。

羅如墉〔貫江西吉安府廬陵縣，民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字本崇，行三，年三十九，七月初四日生〕。曾祖伯剛〔元進士〕；祖彥偲；父惟〔目助〕；母王氏。永感下。兄本貞、本寧。娶郭氏，繼室郭氏。江西鄉試第二十名，會試第一百十六名。
translation_en:
Third Class (Disanjia), 96 candidates, conferred the status of Fellow of the Metropolitan Graduates (Tong jinshi chushen).

Deng Gui 鄧貴: A native of Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered under a civilian household, and a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name is Anda, he is the first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty years old, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather is Wenyu, his grandfather is Chongxu, his father is Jiahui (District Magistrate of Changshu), and his mother is née Xia. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Andao and Anyu. He married née Gao, with née Luo as his second wife. He placed third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Yong 秦顒: A native of Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached (Zhili), registered under a military household, and a military student at the school of the Guizhou Pacification Commission (Xuanweishisi) specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing). His courtesy name is Shi'ang, he is the first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty years old, born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather is Zhongming (Platoon Commander [Baihu]), his grandfather is Mengli, his father is Yi, and his mother is née Zhu. Both his parents are living. His younger brother is Xian. He married née Xi. He placed eleventh in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 104th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Luo Ruyong 羅如墉: A native of Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered under a civilian household, and a county school student specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing). His courtesy name is Benchong, he is the third in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-nine years old, born on the fourth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather is Bogang (a Yuan-dynasty metropolitan graduate [jinshi]), his grandfather is Yansi, his father is Weimu [? 惟〔目助〕, likely a transcription split of the character 眝 Zhu], and his mother is née Wang. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Benzhen and Benning. He married née Guo, with another née Guo as his second wife. He placed twentieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 116th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He placed thirty-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gan Ze 甘澤 [registered in Kaizhou, Daming Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under military household status; an Added Student of the Subprefectural School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Hongji, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the second month]. He is unmarried. He ranked twenty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Ji 朱驥 (registered in a civilian household of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; an Added County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Hanfang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Boheng; his grandfather was Gui'er; his father was Shijin; and his mother is née Jiang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Hanyi and Hanzhao, and his younger brothers are Hanrong and Hanxiang. He married née Tang. translation_en:
Gao An 高安 [registered in a civilian household of Yongfeng County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Confucian scholar (rushi); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Rongjing; sixth in his generation's birth order; aged twenty-seven; born on the nineteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Gao Maoda 茂大; his grandfather was Gao Guifang 桂芳; his father was Gao Lian 璉 [Instructor of the Nanxiong Prefectural School]; his mother was née Jiang 江氏; and his stepmother was née Yao 姚氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Rongzhi 容止, and he married née Zeng 曾氏. He placed nineteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Shen 謝紳 [registered in a civilian household of Wan'an County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi;Added Student (zengguang sheng) at the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Weiyi; first in his generation's birth order; aged twenty-nine; born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xie Gengyin 耕隱; his grandfather was Xie Jingchang 敬常 [Prefectural Judge of Tingzhou Prefecture]; his father is Xie Zaiqu 載驅; his mother was née Zou 鄒氏; and his stepmother is née Zou 鄒氏. His father and stepmother are both living. His younger brothers are Weidu 偉度 and Weixuan 偉選, and he married née Lai 賴氏. He placed ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Zheng 徐正 [registered in a civilian household of Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); [...] Student at the County School; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Weizhong; second in his generation's birth order; aged twenty-six; born on the second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Shou 壽; his grandfather is Xu Rong 榮; his father is Xu Zhongshan 仲善 [Assistant Magistrate of Taoyuan County]; and his mother is née Yang 楊氏. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Weizhi 惟直, and he is betrothed to née Wang 王氏. He placed eighty-second in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Shi 李實 [registered in a civilian household of Hezhou Subprefecture, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; Subprefectural School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Mengcheng; second in his generation's birth order; aged thirty; born on the twentieth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Youzheng 友政; his grandfather is Li Yonggong 永恭; his father is Li Xiang 祥; and his mother is née Ke 柯氏. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Maochun 茂春; his younger brothers are Maolin 茂林, Maohua 茂華, Maocai 茂才, and Maoying 茂英; and he married née Xiong 熊氏. He placed twenty-fifth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Huang Shijun 黃仕儁 (registered in a civilian household of Fushun County 富順縣, Xuzhou Prefecture 敘州府, Sichuan 四川; County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Tingchen 廷臣; second in his generation; aged thirty-eight, born on the fourth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Guilin 桂林, his grandfather was Tiangui 天貴, his father was Zhi 志, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Shijue 仕爵, and his younger brothers are Shilu 仕禄, Shiduo 仕鐸, Shiding 仕定, Shizheng 仕政, and Shichun 仕春. He married née Zhang 張氏, and his second wife is née Hu 胡氏. He placed first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Li 王理 (registered in a civilian household of Anfu County 安福縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Shuyong 淑庸; fourth in his generation; aged thirty-nine, born on the second day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wenjiang 文江, his grandfather was Xishan 希善, his father is Chongrong 充榮, and his mother is née Liu 劉氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chengxun 承恂, Chengming 承明, and Chengjian 承鑑, and his younger brother is Shutong 淑同. He married née Yin 尹氏. He placed fortieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Xian 馬顯 (registered in a civilian household of Guangping County 廣平縣, Guangping Prefecture 廣平府, Direct-attached [Zhili 直隸]; County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenming 文明; second in his generation; aged twenty-six, born on the eighth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Si 駟, his grandfather was De 德, his father is Zhen 禎, and his mother is née Duan 段氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Zong 宗, and his younger brothers are Rong 容, Bao 寶, and Fu 富. He married née Wu 武氏. He placed third in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Ying 張瑛 (registered in a civilian household of Qiantang County 錢塘縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江; Student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng] specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Tingyu 廷玉; first in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Guangyuan 光遠, his grandfather was Gui 貴 (posthumously honoured as Vice Director of the Bureau of Evaluations in the Ministry of Personnel), his father was Xin 信 (Director of the Bureau of Honours in the Ministry of Personnel), and his mother is née Pan 潘氏 (invested as Lady of Suitability [Yiren]). His mother is living. His younger brother is Lin 璘. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed third in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Ma Xu 馬頊 (registered as a civilian in Shanyang County, Huai'an Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shiqin, sixth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Shi'an, his grandfather was Dafang, his father was Xibai, and his mother was née Dai. His mother is living (father deceased). His elder brothers are Dun, Yong, Yu, Xian, and Zhuan; his younger brothers are Gu, Shun, Yan, Shuo, Fu, and Lu; he is married to née Zhu. He placed fifty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Zhong 唐鍾 (registered as a civilian in Qian Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Tingyong, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the fourth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zhu (Assistant Instructor of the Qian Subprefectural School under the Yuan), his grandfather was Jing, his father was Jin, and his mother was née Geng. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Qin and Zhu; he is married to née Ju. He placed ninth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Shan 徐善 (registered as a civilian in Jinyun County, Chuzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenshan, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the fifth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhongju, his grandfather was Jingyang, his father was Deda, and his mother was née Tao. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wenying and Wenzhe; he is married to née Li. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Bi 路璧 (registered as a civilian in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Feizi, sixth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the eighth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Wenming, his grandfather was Zhongjie, his father was Shiqing, and his mother was née Liu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Fei'ao and Feizhuan; his younger brothers are Zun, Xiang, and Fu; he is married to née Zhou. He placed thirty-first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

尹禮〔貫江西吉安府永新縣官籍，涿州學軍生，治《禮記》，字內則，行二，年四十，十一月初十日生〕。曾祖佑卿，祖慶宗，父子齊，母吳氏。具慶下。兄義〔蜀府教授〕，弟智、信、中、和。娶李氏。順天府鄉試第九名，會試第十名。
translation_en:
Yin Kuang 尹鉱 (registered in a military household in the Guang'an Independent Chiliarchy Command under the Sichuan Regional Military Commission; a Stipendiary Student of the Ba County School specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Taihe; first in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month): his great-grandfather was Chao-yi, his grandfather Quan, his father Qian, and his mother née Hou. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Jian and Zi. He married née Tu. He placed forty-first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Sou 王廋 (registered in a civilian household in Jiangxia County, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; a Directorate Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zhongjing; second in his generation; age thirty-six, born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month): his great-grandfather was Tingji, his grandfather Tianxiang, his father Wengui, and his mother née Tan. His mother is living. His elder brother is Guang, and his younger brother is Shu. He married née Wu, with née Liu as his successor wife. He placed ninth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Hao 陳浩 (registered in a civilian household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; an Added Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Zhongzhi; second in his generation; age twenty-three, born on the eighteenth day of the intercalary first month): his great-grandfather was Gui, his grandfather Boda, his father Wenbi (District Magistrate of Shishou), and his mother née Zhang. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Mengren, and his younger brother is Jiqing. He is betrothed to née Ruan. He placed eighteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yin Li 尹禮 (registered in an official household in Yongxin County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Military Student of the Zhuo Subprefectural School specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Neize; second in his generation; age forty, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month): his great-grandfather was Youqing, his grandfather Qingzong, his father Ziqi, and his mother née Wu. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Yi (Professor in the Princely Establishment of Shu), and his younger brothers are Zhi, Xin, Zhong, and He. He married née Li. He placed ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Lang Sheng 郎勝: Registered in a civilian household of Jiande County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Rubin 汝彬, seventh in generational seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Lang Zhan 旃; his grandfather was Lang Xi 希; his father is Lang Shiyuan 士原; and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Rubin's brothers Ruxue 汝學 and Rugang 汝綱, and his younger brother is Ruming 汝明. He married a woman née Sun 孫氏. He placed forty-first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wen 章文: Registered in a civilian household of Lin'an County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yanying 彥英, second in generational seniority, aged forty-two, born on the fifth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zheng 政; his grandfather was Zhang Shouwu 壽五; his father was Zhang Wenfu 文富; and his mother was née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He married a woman née Hong 洪氏. He placed thirty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Dao 謝䆃: Registered in a civilian household of Linhai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Bangda 邦達, second in generational seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the eighth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Xie Yanzhuang 彥莊; his grandfather is Xie Yinfu 尹輔; his father is Xie Yi 宜 (retired Subprefectural Magistrate of Fenzhou); and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Xie Kai 垲 and Xie Chi 墀, and his younger brothers are Xie Yin 垠 and Xie Bi 璧 (and Jian, Kang [?]). He married a woman née Zheng 鄭氏. He placed thirteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bi Luan 畢鸞: Registered in a civilian household of Jingxing County, Zhending Prefecture, Zhili; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Chongxiao 冲霄, third in generational seniority, aged thirty-nine, born on the fourth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Bi Cheng 誠; his grandfather was Bi Sizhong 思中; his father was Bi Guan 貫 (Subprefectural Director of Studies of Juzhou); and his mother was née Li 李氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Bi Lin 麟 and Bi Feng 鳳, and his younger brother is Bi Peng 鵬. He married a woman née Jiao 焦氏. He placed thirteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Weng Shizi 翁世資 [native of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian, of civilian registration; a National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shizi 世資, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Weng Daoyuan 道源, his grandfather was Weng Shining 仕寧, his father is Weng Ying 瑛 [Instructor in the National University (guozi zhujiao)], his mother was née Zhou 周氏, and his stepmother is née Wang 王氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Weng Shiyong 世用 and Weng Wenxian 文賢; his younger brothers are Weng Qing 清, Weng Yue 嶽, Weng Song 嵩, Weng Cen 岑, Weng Yin 銀, and Weng Duo 鐸. He is married to née Song 宋氏. He placed 7th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 7th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xia Yu 夏裕 [native of Fuqing County 福清縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian, of civilian registration; an Added Student of the County School (xianxue zengguang sheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kongyu 孔裕, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Xia Rui 瑞, his grandfather was Xia De 德, his father is Xia Guanming 觀銘, his mother was née Zhang 張氏, and his stepmother is née Mo 莫氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Xia Hui 輝, Xia Can 璨, and Xia Bing 秉; his younger brothers are Xia Yao 耀 and Xia Dun 敦. He is married to née Chen 陳氏. He placed 14th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 43rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Jing 鄭敬 [native of Fuqing County 福清縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian, of military registration; a Student of the Dongguan County School 東莞縣學 in Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府 specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Deju 德聚, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the twenty-second day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Cheng 誠, his grandfather was Zheng Xian 賢, his father is Zheng Yong 永, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zheng Bin 斌 and Zheng Fu 敷; his younger brother is Zheng Min 敏. He is married to née Zheng 鄭氏. He placed 29th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 54th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Kuan 閻寬 [native of Le'an County 樂安縣, Qingzhou Prefecture 青州府, Shandong, of civilian registration; a National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dehou 德厚, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-nine, born on the seventh day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Yan Tingyu 庭玉, his grandfather was Yan Tianxi 添錫, his father is Yan Hui 輝, and his mother was née Wang 王氏. His father is living. His elder brother is Yan Dezhuang 德莊; his younger brother is Yan Dehui 德惠. He is married to née Yang 楊氏. He placed 2nd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 88th in the Metropolitan Examination.

黃宗〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣民籍，府學增廣生，治《詩經》，字廷禮，行一，年三十六，五月初五日生〕。曾祖德寧，祖居昌，父惟清，母沈氏。嚴侍下。弟宣、宏。娶沈氏。應天府鄉試第三十一名，會試第一百四十七名。
translation_en:
Hu Guan 胡貫 [registered in a military household in Meizhou 眉州, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yiguan 一貫; second in generational order; forty-four sui, born on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Yanxiang 彥祥, his grandfather was Hu Yunzhong 允中, his father was Hu Zhigao 志高, his mother was née Huang 黃氏, and his stepmother was née Ruan 阮氏. His mother (stepmother) is living. He has an elder brother, Jun 濬, and younger brothers, Lan 瀾, Chao 潮, Cheng 澄, Hai 海, Shen 深, and Hao 灝. He married a woman née Xiao 蕭氏. He placed forty-third in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Ang 曾昂 [registered in a civilian household in Tongliang County 銅梁縣, Hezhou 合州, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zhongying 仲英; seventh in generational order; twenty-eight sui, born on the sixth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zeng Zongben 宗本, his grandfather was Zeng Yitai 以泰, his father is Zeng Chaogui 朝貴, his legal mother is née Lin 林氏, and his birth mother is née Cai 蔡氏. Both of his parents are living. He has elder brothers, Xi 晰, Wang 旺, Yu 昱, Bing 昞, Sheng 晟, and Xuan 暄. He married a woman née Lai 來氏, and took a woman née Zhao 趙氏 as his second wife. He placed thirty-third in the Sichuan 四川 Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zuo Fu 左輔 [registered in a civilian household in Anfu County 安福縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi; student of the Jinzhou 金州 Subprefectural School in Shaanxi; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Liangbi 良弼; first in generational order; twenty-seven sui, born on the eleventh day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zuo Dongwu 東吾, his grandfather was Zuo Bogong 伯恭, his father is Zuo Renhong 仁弘, and his mother was née Peng 彭氏. His father is living. He is unmarried. He placed thirty-second in the Shaanxi 陝西 Provincial Examination and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Zong 黃宗 [registered in a civilian household in Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Additional Student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingli 廷禮; first in generational order; thirty-six sui, born on the fifth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Dening 德寧, his grandfather was Huang Juchang 居昌, his father is Huang Weiqing 惟清, and his mother was née Shen 沈氏. His father is living. He has younger brothers, Xuan 宣 and Hong 宏. He married a woman née Shen 沈氏. He placed thirty-first in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

芮釗〔貫順天府通州寶坻縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字宗遠，行二，年三十五，五月十六日生〕。曾祖宏甫；祖仲琚；父琦；嫡母陳氏，生母陳氏。具慶下。兄貴清，弟鑑、鍾、銅。娶許氏。順天府鄉試第七十二名，會試第二十名。

辛浩〔貫湖廣武昌府江夏縣軍籍，府學增廣生，治《書經》，字養正，行一，年二十九，十二月十五日生〕。曾祖仲宜；祖景中；父友直〔前濬縣儒學訓導〕；母嚴氏。慈侍下。弟治、洪、澧、溥。娶奚氏，繼室吳氏。湖廣鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百二十六名。

劉懷〔貫順天府大興縣富戶籍，國子生，治《書經》，字以德，行一，年三十，五月初九日生〕。曾祖寳二；祖仲善；父昇宗；母李氏。具慶下。弟鑑。娶于氏。順天府鄉試第四十八名，會試第五十九名。

translation_en:
Rui Zhao 芮釗 [registered in a civilian household of Baodi County 寶坻縣 in Tongzhou Department 通州, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; National University Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zongyuan 宗遠; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Rui Hongfu 宏甫, his grandfather was Rui Zhongju 仲琚, his father is Rui Qi 琦, his legal mother is née Chen 陳, and his birth mother is née Chen 陳. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Rui Guiqing 貴清, and his younger brothers are Rui Jian 鑑, Rui Zhong 鍾, and Rui Tong 銅. He is married to née Xu 許. He placed seventy-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xin Hao 辛浩 [registered in a military household of Jiangxia County 江夏縣, Wuchang Prefecture 武昌府, Huguang 湖廣; Added Student (zengguang sheng) at the Prefectural Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yangzheng 養正; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Xin Zhongyi 仲宜, his grandfather was Xin Jingzhong 景中, his father was Xin Youzhi 友直 [formerly Assistant Instructor (xundao) at the Confucian School of Jun County 濬縣], and his mother is née Yan 嚴. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Xin Zhi 治, Xin Hong 洪, Xin Li 澧, and Xin Pu 溥. He married née Xi 奚, and his second wife is née Wu 吳. He placed twenty-fifth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Huai 劉懷 [registered in an affluent household (fuhu) of Daxing County 大興縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; National University Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yide 以德; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the ninth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Bao'er 寳二, his grandfather was Liu Zhongshan 仲善, his father is Liu Shengzong 昇宗, and his mother is née Li 李. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Liu Jian 鑑. He is married to née Yu 于. He placed forty-eighth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Yu 董昱 [registered in a civilian household of Huo County 漷縣 in Tongzhou Department 通州, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; Student (xuesheng) at the County Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenzhao 文昭; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Dong Cheng 成, his grandfather was Dong Gong 恭, his father was Dong Zihe 子和, and his mother is née Zhang 張. His mother is living. His elder brother is Dong Xian 暹. He is married to née Wu 武. He placed thirty-first in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and one hundred twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Luo Min 駱敏 (registered in a civilian household of Hukou County, Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shicong 士聰; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the tenth day of the first lunar month). His great-grandfather was Dengsi 登四; his grandfather was Hong'er 洪二; his father is Qicheng 啓誠, his mother was Madam Yu 喻氏, and his stepmother is Madam Shen 審氏 [?]. Both parents are living (father and stepmother). His elder brother is Chang 敞, and his younger brothers are Jiao 敫, Zi 孜, Chang 敞 [?], and Fu 敷. He is married to Madam You 游氏. He placed 15th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 3rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ouyang Zheng 歐陽正 (registered in a civilian household of Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student of the Xinchang County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Kaizheng 楷正; first in seniority among brothers; aged forty-four, born on the second day of the first lunar month). His great-grandfather was Junmin 均民; his grandfather was Congshan 從善; his father was Chongxiao 冲霄, and his mother is Madam Zhou 周氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Kaimo 楷謨 and Kaifan 楷範. He is married to Madam Huang 黃氏. He placed 26th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 138th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qiang Hong 強宏 (registered in a civilian household of Ruyang County, Runing Prefecture, Henan; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Shirong 仕容; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fifth day of the ninth lunar month). His great-grandfather was Ru 儒 (Yuan-dynasty Instructor); his grandfather was Shun 順 (former Registrar of Runing Prefecture); his father was Shu 恕, and his mother is Madam Hu 胡氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are An 安 and Ning 寧. He is married to Madam Yang 楊氏. He placed 40th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 83rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Wang Shi'an 士安 (Assistant Magistrate of Tang County under the Yuan), his grandfather was Wang Yu 郁 (Commissioner of the Yongfeng Granary in Yizhou), his father was Wang Jun 俊, and his mother is née Liu 劉氏. Yang Guan 楊觀 (registered in Xindu County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, under civilian household status; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shangbin 尚賓; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Yang Wenbao 文寶, his grandfather was Yang Xueke 學可, his father was Yang Chongjie 崇節, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yang Shi 軾, Yang Ni 輗, and Yang Yue 軏; his younger brothers are Yang Zai 載, Yang Lu 輅, Yang Sheng 升, and Yang Jin 晋. He was married to a woman née Zheng 鄭氏, with a second wife née Hu 胡氏. He ranked twelfth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Xiang 曹祥 (registered in Huojia County, Weihui Prefecture, Henan, under civilian household status; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhihe 致和; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Cao Duan 端, his grandfather was Cao Kuan 寬, his father is Cao Deming 得明, and his mother is née Jia 賈氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Cao Zhen 禎, and his younger brothers are Cao Yongyou 永祐, Cao Yongfu 永福, and Cao Yonglu 永禄. He is married to a woman née Guo 郭氏. He ranked thirty-seventh in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Ning 鄭寧 (registered in Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, under civilian household status; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhidao 志道; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the third day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Caixing 才興, his grandfather was Zheng Dechun 得春, his father is Zheng Yanhui 彦輝, and his mother is née Sun 孫氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zheng Xian 憲, Zheng Xuan 宣, and Zheng Yin 寅, and his younger brother is Zheng Hong 宏. He is betrothed to a woman née Yan 晏氏. He ranked twentieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Mingde 明德; his grandfather was Jingshu 敬叔; his father is Bangxing 邦興 (Assistant Subprefectural Magistrate of Jun Subprefecture 鈞州); his legal mother is née Zhou 周氏, and his birth mother is née Pang 龐氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Wenzhong 文忠. He is married to née Xu 徐氏. He ranked eighty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Zhen 黃禎 (registered in a civilian household of Yongfeng County 永豐縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yingzhi 應祉; first in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yuanli 原禮; his grandfather was Fuxing 復省; his father is Zhongchi 仲篪; his mother is née Xu 徐氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Shouzhen 守真. He is married to née Zeng 曾氏. He ranked fifteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Xian 劉賢 (registered in a military household of Houguan County 候官縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Shiju 時舉; ninth in his generation; age forty-four, born on the twenty-fifth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Fu 福; his grandfather was You 祐; his father was He 和; his mother was née Zheng 鄭氏, and his stepmother was née Zhao 趙氏. Both parents are deceased. He is married to née Lin 林氏. He ranked sixty-third in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ren Ning 任寧 (registered in a military household of Lintong County 臨潼縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Jingzhi 靖之; first in his generation; age thirty-four, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Daoyuan 道遠; his grandfather was Boyi 博乂; his father is Hui 輝; his mother is née Huang 黃氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Xuan 宣, Zhai 宅, Hong 宏, and Yu 宇. He married née Dong 董氏, and his second wife is née Zhao 趙氏. He ranked seventh in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Huang Ziyu 子玉, his grandfather was Huang Yuanshan 原善, his father is Huang Wenyong 文用, and his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. Both parents are living; he has a younger brother, Zhen 震, and is married to née Song 宋氏. Yang Yu 楊愈 (registered under a civilian household in Dangtu District, Taiping Prefecture in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili], a District School Student, specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing], courtesy name Xixian 希賢, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the fourteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yang Gui 貴, his grandfather was Yang Yanli 彥禮, his father was Yang Yong 永, and his mother was née Guo 郭氏. Both parents are deceased; he has elder brothers Zhen 真 and Zhong 忠, and younger brothers Mao 茂 and Guan 觀, and is married to née Zhu 朱氏. He placed forty-third in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qiu Song 丘嵩 (registered under a civilian household in Nancheng District, Jianchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, a District School Student, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu], courtesy name Chonggao 崇高, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the first day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Qiu Sizhao 思昭, his grandfather was Qiu Yongzhao 用昭, his father was Qiu Bingjian 冰鑑, and his mother was née Gong 龔氏. Both parents are deceased; he is married to née Wang 王氏. He placed third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Kan 李侃 (registered under a civilian household in Dong'an District, Shuntian Prefecture, an Added Student at the District School, specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji], courtesy name Xizheng 希正, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Li Yanwen 彥聞 (Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts in the Yuan dynasty, enfeoffed as Duke of Chu), his grandfather was Li Jiben 繼本 (a metropolitan graduate [jinshi] of the Yuan dynasty), his father is Li Dong 東 (retired Left Deputy Director of the Messenger Office), and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Yu 俁 and Shen 伸 (Assistant Instructor at the Guantao District School), and is married to née Zhang 張氏. He placed forty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Shen Ne 沈訥 (registered in a physician household of Kunshan County 崑山縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; an added student of the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zimin 子敏; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Shen Shuyang 叔陽 (Principal of the Medical School in the Yuan dynasty), his grandfather was Shen Shiyi 士怡, his father is Shen Mengzhou 孟舟, and his mother is née Xu 徐氏. Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Shen Yu 愚, Shen Lu 魯, and Shen Zhi 質; he is married to a woman née Hang 杭氏. He placed ninth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 127th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Sen 錢森 (registered in a military household of Cixi County 慈谿縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; an added student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingmao 廷茂; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Qian Junju 均舉, his grandfather is Qian Rongzhong 榮中, his father is Qian Qizong 起宗, and his mother is née Yu 余氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living; his elder brothers are Qian Sun 蓀 and Qian Zhi 芝, and his younger brother is Qian Hui 蕙; he is married to a woman née Shen 沈氏. He placed thirty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhong Cheng 鍾成 (registered in an artisan household of Yuanwu County 原武縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; a student of the county school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Ziwan 子完; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhong Tai 泰, his grandfather was Zhong Zhen 真, his father was Zhong Xian 賢, and his mother is née Hu 胡氏. His mother is living (his father being deceased); his elder brothers are Zhong Zilong 子隆 and Zhong Ziying 子英, and his younger brother is Zhong Zizhou 子周; he was married to a woman née Yin 尹氏, and his second wife is née Chen 陳氏. He placed eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wenzhi 張文質 (registered in a civilian household of Changli County 昌黎縣, Yongping Prefecture 永平府, Northern Metropolitan Area 直隸; a student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yunzhong 允中; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Jihe 継和, his grandfather was Zhang Guang 廣 (Granary Commissioner of the Zhuanglang Guard 莊浪衛 in Shaanxi 陝西), his father was Zhang Jian 鑑, and his mother is née Yang 楊氏. His mother is living (his father being deceased); he is married to a woman née Wang 王氏. He placed second in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 129th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Both of his parents are deceased; his elder brother is Hao Guan 瓘, his younger brothers are Hao Zhen 珍 and Hao Lian 璉, and he married Lady Li 李氏. He placed fourth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Wen 熊文 [registered in a civilian household of Xinjian County 新建縣 in Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Yankui 彥奎; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six; born on the sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiong Sheng 升, his grandfather was Xiong Da 達, his father is Xiong Chen 琛 [Chief of Police (limu) of Quan Department 全州, Guangxi], and his mother is Lady Lu 盧氏. Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Xiong Ren 仁, Xiong Zhi 智, and Xiong Kan 侃, his younger brother is Xiong Biao 彪, and he married Lady Wei 魏氏, with Lady Huang 黃氏 as his second wife. He placed tenth in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Ruyan 陳汝言 [registered in a hereditary official household of the Tongguan Guard 潼關衛 in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Nezhi 訥之; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven; born on the second day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Zongyu 宗虞, his grandfather was Chen Xing 興 [Yuan-dynasty Overseer (darughachi) of Wanping County 宛平縣], his father was Chen Chun 純, and his mother was Lady Ma 馬氏. Both of his parents are deceased; his elder brother is Chen Qi 玘, his younger brothers are Chen Yan 琰 and Chen Li 理, and he married Lady Qian 錢氏, with Lady Wu 吳氏 as his second wife. He placed third in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bai Gui 白圭 [registered in a civilian household of Nangong County 南宮縣 in Ji Department 冀州, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); County School Student (xianxuesheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Zongyu 宗玉; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-four; born on the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Bai Wenju 文舉, his grandfather was Bai Jinzhong 進忠, his father is Bai Youliang 友諒, his mother was Lady Guo 郭氏, and his stepmother is Lady He 何氏. His father and stepmother are both living; his elder brothers are Bai Qin 欽 and Bai Rong 瑢, his younger brothers are Bai Xuan 瑄 and Bai Zhen 珍, and he married Lady Qin 秦氏. He placed forty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Qi 劉玘 (registered in a military household in Jingyang County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a military student in the Suide Subprefectural School; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Zhongyu; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twentieth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Liu Zong (Instructor in the Fushi County School under the Yuan dynasty), his grandfather was Liu Zhen, his father is Liu Sheng, and his mother is née Gao. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Liu Yu and Liu Wen, his younger brother is Liu Chen, and he is married to née Ye. He placed twenty-second in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Quan 陳銓 (registered in a civilian household in Sishui County, Zhengzhou Subprefecture, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a County School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Wenheng; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Zhongyuan, his grandfather was Chen Siming, his father was Chen Yuan (Instructor in the local County School), his mother was née Hu, and his stepmother is née Huang. His mother is living (his father having died); his elder brother is Chen Jian, his younger brother is Chen Dun, and he is married to née Wang. He placed thirty-third in the Henan Provincial Examination and eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ni Rang 倪讓 (registered in a military household in Quanjiao County, Chuzhou Subprefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a military student in the Qingyang Prefectural School; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Yungong; third in seniority among brothers; aged forty-three, born on the second day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Ni Xing, his grandfather was Ni Juexian, his father was Ni Qing, his mother was née Li, and his stepmother was née Liu. Both parents are deceased; his elder brothers are Ni Jian and Ni Wang, and he is married to née Wang. He placed tenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Rang 劉讓 (registered in a civilian household in Cangzhou Subprefecture, Hejian Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Subprefectural School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Huiqian; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Yanhe, his grandfather was Liu Tongfu, his father was Liu Hao, and his mother is née Li. His mother is living (his father having died); his elder brother is Liu Jing, and he is married to née Wang. He placed twelfth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xue Yuan 薛遠 (registered in a military household of Chao County 巢縣, Wuwei Subprefecture 無為州, Luzhou Prefecture 廬州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; an added student [zengguangsheng 增廣生] at the Danzhou Subprefectural School 儋州學 in Guangdong; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jiyuan 繼遠; fifth in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the third day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Xue Shunqing 舜卿; his grandfather was Xue Xiang 祥 (Minister of Works); his father was Xue Neng 能; his principal mother was Lady Ouyang 歐陽氏, and his birth mother was Lady Shen 沈氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Jishan 繼善, Jilong 繼隆, and Jichang 繼常. He married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed thirty-eighth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 109th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yao 李瑤 (registered in a civilian household of Longqing Subprefecture 隆慶州, Northern Metropolitan Area 直隸; a subprefectural school student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhongyu 仲玉; third in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Yuanju 元舉 (Assistant Prefect of Taiping Prefecture 太平府); his grandfather was Li Zezheng 則政; his father is Li Ying 英 (former Instructor of the Huarong County School 華容縣學); his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Qiong 瓊 and Zan 瓚, and his younger brother is Xiang 珦. He married Lady Xu 胥氏. He placed thirty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Hui 張惠 (registered in a military household of Jizhou Subprefecture 吉州, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi; a subprefectural school student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zemin 澤民; fourth in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Kezheng 克政; his grandfather was Zhang Minzhong 敏中; his father was Zhang Jingduan 景端 (Magistrate of Neiqiu County 內丘); his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhen 真, Lan 蘭, and Chun 春 (General). He married Lady Hao 郝氏. He placed thirty-sixth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 146th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cheng Xin 程信 (registered in a military household of Xiuning County 休寧縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; a military student at the Hejian County School 河間縣學, Hejian Prefecture 河間府, Northern Metropolitan Area 直隸; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yanshi 彥實; first in seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the sixteenth day of the intercalary fifth month). His great-grandfather was Cheng Jifu 吉輔; his grandfather is Cheng Dushou 杜壽; his father is Cheng Sheng 晟; his mother is Lady Zhang 張氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Bi 佖. He married Lady Lin 林氏. He placed twenty-third in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

薛幹〔貫直隸真定府趙州臨城縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字景廉，行一，年三十二，十二月初八日生〕。曾祖敬，祖弘友，父志剛，母員氏。具慶下。弟彬、端。娶張氏。順天府鄉試第九十七名，會試第四十九名。

萬祥〔貫江西南昌府南昌縣民籍，府學增廣生，治《書經》，字載道，行一，年三十，八月初二日生〕。曾祖以新，祖汝行，父成易，母朱氏。慈侍下。娶楊氏。江西鄉試第三十名，會試第六十名。
translation_en:
Chang Mao 常茂 (native of Jiaocheng County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi, of military household registration; a County School Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Jingrong, first in his generation; aged thirty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhongqian, his grandfather Huaide, his father Shuzhang, and his mother née Sheng. His father is living. His elder brothers are Shangzhi, Shangren, Shangsheng, and Shangyi; his younger brother is Shangyong; he is married to née Liu. He placed thirty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xue Gan 薛幹 (native of Lincheng County, Zhao Subprefecture, Zhending Prefecture, Zhili, of civilian household registration; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jinglian, first in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Jing, his grandfather Hongyou, his father Zhigang, and his mother née Yun. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Bin and Duan; he is married to née Zhang.
